services.name: Venue Rental
services.desc: Make sure to visit Artworks, one of the three official venues for the 80th Annual Sweetheart Festival, for a creative, come-and-go experience packed with local art, cash bar and hands-on fun. Browse an artisan pop-up market and the Artworks Gallery Gift Shop for unique, locally made treasures, then jump into all-ages make-and-take projects led by resident artists during the Make & Take Studio Sessions (10:00AM-1:30PM and 2:00PM-5:30PM, while supplies last). While you’re there, don’t miss “Tell Me a Love Story,” an interactive installation inviting you to share and reflect on love in its many forms. Don’t forget to grab your passport stamp! services.desc: Ink and Canvas: A Tattoo ExhibitionOpening Reception: Friday, July 11, 6-9pmExhibition Runs: July 11 - Aug 30, 2025 This exhibition is aiming to center the tattoo as artwork as well as the tattooist and what they may create outside of their studio practice. Whether that be flash sheets, photography of their tattoos or additional work, digital art, 2D and 3D work.Let’s take the time to see the tattoo artist not only as someone willing to break the social mold, but celebrate them as multimedia fine artists.
